name: Top 10 processes by logical reads
description: Active sessions ordered by logical reads.
sql:
select top 10
    mp.spid, suser_name(mp.serveruserid) as login_name, mp.command as cmd,
    mp.dbname as db, mp.hostname, mp.application as program,
    mps.cputime as cpu, mps.PhysicalReads as p_reads, mps.LogicalReads as l_reads,
    mps.RowsAffected as [rows]
from master..monProcess mp
join master..monProcessStatement mps on mp.spid = mps.spid
where mp.spid <> @@spid
order by mps.LogicalReads desc

name: Top 10 processes by CPU
description: Active sessions ordered by accumulated CPU time.
sql:
select top 10
    mp.spid, suser_name(mp.serveruserid) as login_name, mp.command as cmd,
    mp.dbname as db, mp.hostname, mp.application as program,
    mps.cputime as cpu, mps.LogicalReads as l_reads
from master..monProcess mp
join master..monProcessStatement mps on mp.spid = mps.spid
where mp.spid <> @@spid
order by mps.cputime desc

name: Top server wait events
description: Most significant accumulated wait events.
sql:
select top 20 w.WaitEventID, i.Description, w.Waits, w.WaitTime
from master..monSysWaits w
join master..monWaitEventInfo i on w.WaitEventID = i.WaitEventID
where w.WaitTime > 0
order by w.WaitTime desc

name: Most accessed tables (delta)
description: Compares two monOpenObjectActivity snapshots. Set :interval to 00:00:10 without quotes.
sql:
select DBID, ObjectID, IndexID, LogicalReads, PhysicalReads,
       RowsInserted, RowsDeleted, RowsUpdated
into #T1 from master..monOpenObjectActivity

waitfor delay ':interval'

select DBID, ObjectID, IndexID, LogicalReads, PhysicalReads,
       RowsInserted, RowsDeleted, RowsUpdated
into #T2 from master..monOpenObjectActivity

select top 300
    db          = db_name(t2.DBID),
    object_name        = object_name(t2.ObjectID, t2.DBID),
    t2.IndexID,
    LogicalReads  = t2.LogicalReads  - isnull(t1.LogicalReads, 0),
    PhysicalReads = t2.PhysicalReads - isnull(t1.PhysicalReads, 0),
    RowsInserted  = t2.RowsInserted  - isnull(t1.RowsInserted, 0),
    RowsDeleted   = t2.RowsDeleted   - isnull(t1.RowsDeleted, 0),
    RowsUpdated   = t2.RowsUpdated   - isnull(t1.RowsUpdated, 0)
from #T2 t2, #T1 t1
where t2.DBID = t1.DBID and t2.ObjectID = t1.ObjectID and t2.IndexID = t1.IndexID
and t2.LogicalReads - isnull(t1.LogicalReads, 0) > 0
order by LogicalReads desc

drop table #T1
drop table #T2

name: Spinlock contention (delta)
description: Measures spinlock contention over :interval, for example 00:00:10 without quotes.
sql:
select * into #S1 from master..monSpinlockActivity

waitfor delay ':interval'

select * into #S2 from master..monSpinlockActivity

select top 100
    Spinlock_Name = convert(varchar(50), s2.SpinlockName),
    grabs = s2.Grabs - s1.Grabs,
    spins = s2.Spins - s1.Spins,
    waits = s2.Waits - s1.Waits,
    contention = s2.Contention
from #S2 s2, #S1 s1
where s2.SpinlockSlotID = s1.SpinlockSlotID
order by spins desc

drop table #S1
drop table #S2

name: Device I/O latency (delta)
description: Measures read/write latency in milliseconds over :interval, for example 00:00:10 without quotes.
sql:
select Reads, APFReads, Writes, IOTime, ReadTime, WriteTime, LogicalName, PhysicalName
into #IO1 from master..monDeviceIO

waitfor delay ':interval'

select Reads, APFReads, Writes, IOTime, ReadTime, WriteTime, LogicalName, PhysicalName
into #IO2 from master..monDeviceIO

select
    device = i2.LogicalName, path = i2.PhysicalName,
    latency_ms = convert(numeric(8,2), (i2.IOTime - i1.IOTime) * 1.0
        / ((i2.Reads - i1.Reads) + (i2.APFReads - i1.APFReads) + (i2.Writes - i1.Writes) + 1)),
    read_latency_ms = convert(numeric(8,2), (i2.ReadTime - i1.ReadTime) * 1.0
        / ((i2.Reads - i1.Reads) + (i2.APFReads - i1.APFReads) + 1)),
    write_latency_ms = convert(numeric(8,2), (i2.WriteTime - i1.WriteTime) * 1.0
        / ((i2.Writes - i1.Writes) + 1)),
    reads_delta = i2.Reads - i1.Reads, writes_delta = i2.Writes - i1.Writes
from #IO2 i2, #IO1 i1
where i2.PhysicalName = i1.PhysicalName
order by writes_delta desc

drop table #IO1
drop table #IO2

name: Active sessions
description: Non-sleeping processes with commands and databases. :min_spid filters system SPIDs; use 0 for all or 50 to skip lower IDs.
sql:
select mp.spid, suser_name(mp.serveruserid) as login_name, mp.command as cmd,
    mp.dbname as db, mp.hostname, mp.application as program,
    mp.blockingspid as blocked_by, mp.secondswaiting as sec_wait
from master..monProcess mp
where mp.command not in ('AWAITING COMMAND','SLEEPING','BACKGROUND','CHECKPOINT SLEEP')
  and mp.spid <> @@spid
  and mp.spid > :min_spid
order by mp.spid

name: Process overview (monProcess)
description: Login, command, waits, CPU, I/O, memory and blocker, ordered by wait time.
sql:
select mp.spid, mp.login, mp.dbname as db, mp.command as cmd,
    mp.application as program, mp.hostname,
    mpa.cputime as cpu, mpa.physicalreads as p_reads, mpa.memusagekb as mem_kb,
    mp.secondswaiting as sec_wait, mp.secondsconnected as sec_conn,
    mp.blockingspid as blocked_by, mp.waiteventid
from master..monProcess mp
left join master..monProcessActivity mpa on mp.spid = mpa.spid
where mp.serveruserid <> 0
order by mp.secondswaiting desc

name: Long-idle connections
description: Idle sessions (AWAITING COMMAND / WaitEventID 250) exceeding :idle_seconds seconds.
sql:
select mp.spid, mp.login, mp.application as program, mp.hostname, mp.dbname as db,
    mp.secondswaiting as sec_wait, mp.secondsconnected as sec_conn,
    db_name(tempdb_id(mp.spid)) as assigned_tempdb
from master..monProcess mp
inner join master..sysprocesses s on mp.spid = s.spid
where mp.serveruserid <> 0
  and mp.command = 'AWAITING COMMAND'
  and mp.waiteventid = 250
  and mp.secondswaiting > :idle_seconds
order by mp.secondswaiting desc

name: Session count by application
description: Connection counts by application to identify excessive pools.
sql:
select program_name = isnull(sp.program_name, '(unnamed)'),
    sessions = count(*), sampled_at = getdate()
from master..sysprocesses sp
where sp.program_name is not null
group by sp.program_name
order by count(*) desc

name: Session count by host
description: Connections grouped by client machine.
sql:
select hostname = isnull(sp.hostname, '(no host)'), sessions = count(*)
from master..sysprocesses sp
group by sp.hostname
order by count(*) desc

name: Current SQL for a SPID
description: Captures the current statement for :spid in the Messages panel.
sql:
dbcc traceon(3604)
go
dbcc sqltext(:spid)
go
dbcc traceoff(3604)

name: Blocking chain
description: Blocked processes and their blockers.
sql:
select mp.spid, mp.blockingspid as blocked_by, mp.secondswaiting as sec_wait,
    suser_name(mp.serveruserid) as login_name, mp.command as cmd, mp.dbname as db,
    mp.application as program, mp.hostname
from master..monProcess mp
where isnull(mp.blockingspid,0) <> 0
order by mp.secondswaiting desc

name: Active locks
description: Server locks reported by sp_lock.

name: SPID lock details
description: Objects and TABLE/PAGE/ROW lock levels held by :spid.
sql:
select l.spid, db = db_name(l.dbid), obj_name = object_name(l.ObjectId, l.dbid),
    l.locktype, l.lockLevel, l.PageNumber, l.RowNumber
from master..monLocks l
where l.spid = :spid
order by l.dbid, obj_name

name: Active locks on a table
description: Check locks before reorganization or DDL. Enter :table and :database without quotes.
sql:
select sProc.spid, login = suser_name(sProc.suid), mLocks.lockLevel,
    obj_name = object_name(mLocks.ObjectId, mLocks.DBID)
from master..syslocks sLocks
inner join master..monLocks mLocks on mLocks.spid = sLocks.spid and mLocks.dbid = sLocks.dbid
inner join master..sysprocesses sProc on sProc.spid = sLocks.spid
where object_name(mLocks.ObjectId, mLocks.DBID) = ':table'
and db_name(sLocks.dbid) = ':database'

name: Transactions holding the log
description: Oldest open transaction per database, excluding the replication agent.
sql:
select db = db_name(dbid), spid, xact_name = name, started = starttime,
    age_min = datediff(mi, starttime, getdate())
from master..syslogshold
where name not like '%repl%'
order by starttime asc

name: Long-running transactions
description: Transactions open longer than :open_minutes minutes, with owner and state.
sql:
select db = m.dbname, t.spid, t.xactname, state = t.state, t.starttime,
    age_min = datediff(mi, t.starttime, getdate()),
    login = m.login, program = m.application
from master..systransactions t
left join master..monProcess m on m.spid = t.spid
where datediff(mi, t.starttime, getdate()) >= :open_minutes
order by t.starttime asc

name: Database log segment status
description: Used/free log pages and free percentage via lct_admin. Enter :database without quotes.
sql:
declare @hundred float
select @hundred = 100.0
select db = name,
    UsedPages = lct_admin('num_logpages', dbid),
    FreePages = lct_admin('logsegment_freepages', dbid),
    PctFree = @hundred - lct_admin('num_logpages', dbid) * @hundred
        / (lct_admin('logsegment_freepages', dbid) + lct_admin('num_logpages', dbid))
from master..sysdatabases
where name = ':database'

name: Space usage by database
description: Data and log size in MB; segmap=4 identifies the log segment.
sql:
select db = db_name(dbid),
    data_mb = convert(numeric(12,1), sum(convert(bigint, case when segmap <> 4 then size else 0 end)) * (@@maxpagesize/1024.) / 1024),
    log_mb  = convert(numeric(12,1), sum(convert(bigint, case when segmap = 4 then size else 0 end)) * (@@maxpagesize/1024.) / 1024)
from master..sysusages
group by dbid
order by db_name(dbid)

name: Database data space details
description: Allocated, used and free MB plus utilization, using built-in functions.
sql:
select db = db_name(u.dbid),
    Data_MB  = str(sum(convert(bigint, u.size)) * (@@maxpagesize/1024.) / 1024, 12, 1),
    Used_MB = str((sum(convert(bigint, u.size)) - sum(convert(bigint, curunreservedpgs(u.dbid, u.lstart, u.unreservedpgs))))
                   * (@@maxpagesize/1024.) / 1024, 12, 1),
    Free_MB = str(sum(convert(bigint, curunreservedpgs(u.dbid, u.lstart, u.unreservedpgs)))
                   * (@@maxpagesize/1024.) / 1024, 12, 1),
    Pct_Used = str(100.0 - 100.0 * sum(convert(bigint, curunreservedpgs(u.dbid, u.lstart, u.unreservedpgs)))
                   / sum(convert(bigint, u.size)), 6, 1) + '%'
from master..sysusages u
where u.segmap & 2 = 2 and u.vdevno >= 0
group by u.dbid
order by db

name: Database log space (free %)
description: Log usage via lct_admin, excluding system databases and tempdb.
sql:
select db = name,
    LogUsed_pg = lct_admin('num_logpages', dbid),
    LogFree_pg = lct_admin('logsegment_freepages', dbid),
    Pct_Free = str(100.0 * lct_admin('logsegment_freepages', dbid)
        / (lct_admin('logsegment_freepages', dbid) + lct_admin('num_logpages', dbid) + 1), 6, 1) + '%'
from master..sysdatabases
where name not in ('master','model','sybsystemprocs','sybsystemdb','sybsecurity')
and name not like 'tempdb%'
order by Pct_Free asc

name: Unallocated space by device
description: Device space available for allocation with alter database.
sql:
select Device = d.name, Physical_Path = d.phyname,
    Total_MB = convert(bigint, d.high - d.low + 1) * (@@maxpagesize/1024) / 1024,
    Allocated_MB = isnull(sum(convert(bigint, u.size)) * (@@maxpagesize/1024) / 1024, 0),
    Free_MB = (convert(bigint, d.high - d.low + 1) * (@@maxpagesize/1024) / 1024)
               - isnull(sum(convert(bigint, u.size)) * (@@maxpagesize/1024) / 1024, 0),
    Type = case when (d.status & 2) = 2 then 'Data/Log'
                when (d.status & 4) = 4 then 'Backup/File'
                else 'System/Other' end
from master..sysdevices d
left join master..sysusages u on d.vdevno = u.vstart / 16777216
where d.cntrltype = 0
group by d.name, d.phyname, d.high, d.low, d.status
order by Free_MB desc

name: Table space usage
description: Reserved, data, index and unused space for :table in :database, broken down by index.

name: Largest tables in current database
description: Top 20 tables by size with row counts and data/leaf space in GB/KB.
sql:
select top 20
    Table_Name = left(a.name, 50), Type = a.type, Row_Count = c.rowcnt,
    Data_GB = (((sum(convert(bigint, c.pagecnt) * 2)) / 1024) / 1024),
    Index_GB = (((sum(convert(bigint, c.leafcnt) * 2)) / 1024) / 1024),
    Data_KB = sum(convert(bigint, c.pagecnt) * 2), Index_KB = sum(convert(bigint, c.leafcnt) * 2),
    Total_GB = (((sum(convert(bigint, c.pagecnt) * 2)) / 1024) / 1024) + (((sum(convert(bigint, c.leafcnt) * 2)) / 1024) / 1024)
from sysobjects a, systabstats c
where c.id = a.id and a.type = 'U'
group by a.name, a.type, c.rowcnt
order by Data_GB desc

name: Precise table size
description: Rows and KB using built-ins. Change database first if needed; enter :table without quotes.
sql:
select db = db_name(), table_name = convert(varchar(30), o.name),
    row_count = row_count(db_id(), o.id),
    KB = data_pages(db_id(), o.id, 0) * (@@maxpagesize/1024)
from sysobjects o
where o.type = 'U' and o.name = ':table'

name: Historical row count by day
description: Capacity pattern using date column :date_column and history table :history_table.
sql:
select row_count = count(*),
    year = datepart(yy, :date_column), month = datepart(mm, :date_column), day = datepart(dd, :date_column)
from :history_table
group by datepart(yy, :date_column), datepart(mm, :date_column), datepart(dd, :date_column)
order by 2 desc, 3 desc, 4 desc

name: Tables with stale statistics
description: Finds datachange() >= :min_change_pct percent. Switch to :database first; review before updating statistics.
sql:
select pct_changed = datachange(a.name, null, null), table_name = a.name,
    row_count = b.rowcnt, db = db_name(db_id())
from sysobjects a
inner join systabstats b on a.id = b.id
where a.type = 'U' and b.indid in (0, 1)
and datachange(a.name, null, null) >= :min_change_pct
order by pct_changed desc

name: Unused index candidates
description: Indexes with UsedCount=0 in the current database. Review before dropping.
sql:
select db = db_name(oa.DBID), table_name = object_name(oa.ObjectID, oa.DBID),
    oa.IndexID, index_name = si.name, oa.UsedCount, oa.OptSelectCount
from master..monOpenObjectActivity oa, sysindexes si
where oa.ObjectID = si.id and oa.IndexID = si.indid and oa.DBID = db_id()
and oa.UsedCount = 0 and oa.IndexID > 1 and oa.IndexID != 255
order by table_name, oa.IndexID

name: Generate statistics updates (text)
description: Generates update index statistics for tables matching LIKE :pattern; does not execute the generated text.
sql:
select distinct command = 'update index statistics ' + db_name() + '..' + name
from sysobjects
where type = 'U' and name like ':pattern'
order by command

name: Data caches
description: Data cache configuration via sp_helpcache.

name: Server configuration
description: Current configuration parameters via sp_configure.

name: Engine status
description: Online engines and CPU utilization.
sql:
select EngineNumber, OSPID, Status, CurrentKPID, PreviousKPID,
    ProcessesAffinitied, CPUTime, SystemCPUTime, UserCPUTime, IdleCPUTime,
    Connections, DiskIOCompleted
from master..monEngine
order by EngineNumber

name: Login details (sp_displaylogin)
description: Roles, state and default database for :login. Output appears in Messages; use Login inventory for a grid.

name: Login inventory
description: All logins with default database and lock flag (status & 2).
sql:
select login = l.name, suid = l.suid, default_db = l.dbname,
    locked = case when l.status & 2 = 2 then 'yes' else 'no' end,
    created = l.crdate, full_name = l.fullname
from master..syslogins l
order by l.name

name: Login roles
description: Server roles assigned to :login; enter the login without quotes.
sql:
select login = l.name, role = sr.name
from master..syslogins l
inner join master..sysloginroles lr on lr.suid = l.suid
inner join master..syssrvroles sr on sr.srid = lr.srid
where l.name = ':login'
order by sr.name

name: Login trigger status
description: Checks whether a login trigger is configured.

name: Object permissions (sp_helprotect)
description: Grants and revokes on :object in :database.

name: Replication Agent status
description: Replication Agent state and log position for :database.

name: Listeners and connections (sp_listener)
description: Server listener status.

name: Tables enabled for replication
description: Tables with replication enabled (sysstat2 & 8) in :database.
sql:
use :database
go
select table_name = name
from sysobjects
where type = 'U' and sysstat2 & 8 = 8
order by name

name: Replication exceptions (RSSD)
description: Run in RSSD. Exception queue transactions; :since is YYYYMMDD and :orig_db is the source database without quotes.
sql:
select trans_num = convert(int, substring(sys_trans_id, 5, 8)),
    sys_trans_id, app_trans_name, orig_site, orig_db, orig_time,
    error_site, ds_error, ds_errmsg, error_proc, log_reason, trans_status
from rs_exceptshdr
where orig_time >= ':since' and orig_db = ':orig_db'
order by orig_time desc

name: Kill a SPID
description: Executes kill :spid when you run the recipe. Rollback can take time; server permissions apply.

name: Generate idle-session kills (review)
description: Generates kill statements for sessions idle longer than :idle_seconds seconds. Review the text before executing.
sql:
select command = 'kill ' + convert(varchar(8), s.spid),
    mp.login, mp.application as program, mp.hostname,
    mp.secondswaiting as sec_wait, mp.secondsconnected as sec_conn
from master..monProcess mp
inner join master..sysprocesses s on mp.spid = s.spid
where mp.serveruserid <> 0 and mp.command = 'AWAITING COMMAND'
and mp.waiteventid = 250 and mp.secondswaiting > :idle_seconds
order by mp.secondswaiting desc

name: Truncate a database log
description: Runs dump tran :database with truncate_only. Breaks the dump chain; coordinate with backup operations.

name: Update table statistics
description: Updates statistics for :table in :database. Check locks first.

name: Compact a table
description: Runs reorg compact for DOL :table in :database. Check locks and schedule large tables appropriately.

name: Purge procedure and statement caches
description: Releases cached plans and causes recompilation. Temporarily affects the entire server.
sql:
dbcc traceon(3604)
go
dbcc proc_cache(free_unused)
go
dbcc purgesqlcache
go
dbcc traceoff(3604)

name: Resolve a stuck 2PC transaction
description: Identify :xactname first and enter it without quotes. complete_xact rollback rolls back the prepared transaction.
sql:
dbcc traceon(3604)
go
dbcc complete_xact (':xactname', "rollback", "1pc")
go
dbcc traceoff(3604)

name: Lock or unlock a login
description: Disables access for :login without deleting it. Replace lock with unlock to restore access.

name: Enable or disable table replication
description: Enables replication for :table in :database. Replace true with false to disable.

name: Table sizes across databases (cursor)
description: Iterates CSV :databases using dynamic SQL and a temporary table. Reports rows and data/index GB/KB. Enter database names without quotes.
sql:
create table #table_sizes (
    db varchar(100), TableName varchar(255), type char(2),
    row_count numeric(20,0), DataGB numeric(20,2), IndexGB numeric(20,2),
    DataKB numeric(20,0), IndexKB numeric(20,0), TotalGB numeric(20,2), sampled_at datetime)
go
declare db_cursor cursor for
    select name from master..sysdatabases
    where charindex(',' + name + ',', ',' + ':databases' + ',') > 0
    for read only
go
declare @name varchar(100), @cmd varchar(8000)
open db_cursor
fetch db_cursor into @name
while @@sqlstatus = 0
begin
    select @cmd = 'insert into #table_sizes
        select top 300
            "' + @name + '", a.name, a.type,
            sum(c.rowcnt),
            (((sum(convert(bigint,c.pagecnt)*2))/1024))/1024,
            (((sum(convert(bigint,c.leafcnt)*2))/1024))/1024,
            sum(convert(bigint,c.pagecnt)*2),
            sum(convert(bigint,c.leafcnt)*2),
            (((sum(convert(bigint,c.pagecnt)*2))/1024))/1024 + (((sum(convert(bigint,c.leafcnt)*2))/1024))/1024,
            getdate()
        from ' + @name + '..sysobjects a, ' + @name + '..systabstats c
        where c.id = a.id and a.type = "U"
        group by a.name, a.type
        order by 4 desc'
    exec(@cmd)
    fetch db_cursor into @name
end
close db_cursor
deallocate cursor db_cursor
go
select * from #table_sizes order by TotalGB desc
drop table #table_sizes

name: Server status (sp_iqstatus)
description: Version, page sizes, main and temporary store usage, memory and active transactions.

name: Connections (sp_iqconnection)
description: Every connection with user, last request time, temporary space and IQ cursors.

name: Who is connected (sp_iqwho)
description: Connections and users with their state, similar to sp_who on ASE.

name: Running statements (sp_iqcontext)
description: The statement each connection is executing right now.

name: Connection details (sa_conn_info)
description: Connection number, name, user, last request and blocking connection from the SQL Anywhere layer.

name: Open transactions (sp_iqtransaction)
description: Transactions with their state, start time and the versions they hold.

name: Version usage (sp_iqversionuse)
description: Table versions kept for open transactions and the space they retain.

name: Locks (sp_iqlocks)
description: Locks held in the catalog and IQ stores, with connection and table.

name: Dbspaces (sp_iqdbspace)
description: Each dbspace with size, usage, block type and read-write state.

name: Dbspace files (sp_iqfile)
description: Files behind each dbspace with path, size and usage.

name: Table size (sp_iqtablesize)
description: Rows, KB and pages used by :table (owner.table accepted).

name: Index sizes of a table (sp_iqindexsize)
description: Size of every index on :table, by index type.

name: Tables (sp_iqtable)
description: Tables in the database with owner, dbspace and type.

name: Columns of a table (sp_iqcolumn)
description: Columns of :table with type, width, nullability and cardinality.

name: Indexes of a table (sp_iqindex)
description: Indexes on :table with their columns and IQ index type (FP, HG, LF, DATE…).

name: Views (sp_iqview)
description: Views with owner and definition.

name: Procedures (sp_iqprocedure)
description: Procedures and functions with owner and type.

name: Non-default options (sp_iqcheckoptions)
description: Database and connection options that differ from their defaults.

name: Multiplex nodes (sp_iqmpxinfo)
description: Multiplex servers with role, status and connection details. Empty on a simplex server.

name: Server version
description: Full IQ version string.

name: Drop a connection
description: Drops connection :connection_id. Its open transaction is rolled back; server permissions apply.

name: Version (admin version)
description: Replication Server version.

name: Health summary (admin health)
description: Overall state: HEALTHY, or SUSPECT with the threads that are down.

name: Threads down (admin who_is_down)
description: Threads that are suspended or down, such as DSI or RepAgent user threads.

name: Threads up (admin who_is_up)
description: Threads that are running.

name: Server and RSSD names
description: This Replication Server's name and the ASE server and database that hold its RSSD.

name: Site version (admin show_site_version)
description: Software and site version used for feature compatibility.

name: All threads (admin who)
description: Every thread with its type, state and connection information.

name: DSI threads (admin who, dsi)
description: Data server interface threads: state, transactions applied and commands read.

name: Stable queues (admin who, sqm)
description: Inbound and outbound queues with segments, blocks and the first segment to read: the backlog.

name: Transaction queues (admin who, sqt)
description: Stable queue transaction threads with open, closed and read transactions.

name: Routes (admin who, rsi)
description: Route threads to other Replication Servers.

name: Partition space (admin disk_space)
description: Stable queue partitions with total and used segments.

name: Data server connections (admin show_connections)
description: Connections from this Replication Server to data servers and their state.

name: Logical connections (admin logical_status)
description: Warm standby logical connections with active and standby databases.

name: Quiesce check (admin quiesce_check)
description: Reports whether every queue is empty, for example before maintenance.

name: Database generation (admin get_generation)
description: Generation number of :data_server.:database, used when resetting its secondary truncation point.

name: Suspend a connection
description: Stops applying replicated transactions to :data_server.:database. Its queue keeps growing until you resume.

name: Resume a connection
description: Restarts the DSI for :data_server.:database.

name: Resume skipping the first transaction
description: Resumes :data_server.:database and writes the failed first transaction to the exceptions log instead of applying it. Review it in the RSSD afterwards.

name: Suspend log transfer
description: Disconnects the RepAgent of :data_server.:database from this Replication Server.

name: Resume log transfer
description: Allows the RepAgent of :data_server.:database to connect again.
